messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor Jane from SecureAudit. For SOC 2 control CC6.1 we need evidence for KMS/HSM key rotations and associated audit logs covering 2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30. Specifically: rotation timestamps, actor (who initiated), KMS audit events (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt), CloudHSM module events, and a hash of the delivered bundle. Please upload to the evidence portal or provide a presigned S3 link. Deadline EOD Wed.

sam_engsec: Thanks Jane. Copying @maria_sre and @kevin_devops. Do you want full raw logs or a trimmed evidence bundle + index? :clipboard:

auditor_jane: Trimmed bundle + index is fine as long as it contains unambiguous rotation records and the audit events you mentioned. We also need a short retention statement showing how long those logs are kept and any legal holds that would affect them.

kevin_devops: We can produce that. Plan: export CloudHSM audit logs + KMS key metadata, assemble manifest with hashes, and upload. I'll put the bundle at s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2024/auditor_jane/kms-hsm-rotation-2023-10_2024-09/. Will post presigned link when ready.

maria_sre: Quick note: our policy is KMS audit events retained for 3 years; CloudHSM module events are retained on a 5-year cycle for most customers, but archived copies exist out to 7 years depending on legal hold. I'll include retention statements and the internal ticket that authorizes any extended holds.

sam_engsec: Repro steps for verifier: either download via AWS CLI `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/... ./` or access via internal evidence portal (https://evidence.redwood.ai/login). The manifest will include sha256 checksums for every file and a top-level manifest.json mapping control IDs to evidence files.

auditor_jane: Also need to see which rotations were scheduled vs manual and proof that old key material was retired (no active references). A single example KID per rotation is acceptable if it proves the workflow.

kevin_devops: We'll include CSV manifest with fields: rotation_date, key_id, rotated_by, rotation_type, verification_hash. Example: `2024-03-15,kid-3f5a,ops-kevin,scheduled,sha256:3b9f...`

evidence_bot: Upload started: upload_id=eb-20240912-42 status=processing ETA ~2h :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria_sre: For reproducibility, export snippet we used:
```
# export HSM logs for date range
aws s3 cp s3://cloudhsm-raw/logs/2024-03/ ./ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "cloudhsm-audit-2024-03-*.log"
tar -czvf hsm-logs-2024-03.tar.gz cloudhsm-audit-*.log
sha256sum hsm-logs-2024-03.tar.gz > hsm-logs-2024-03.sha256
```
Include that in the packet so you can verify locally.

sam_engsec: After upload completes I'll assemble the evidence packet, add SOC2 control mapping (CC6.1 -> files), and post presigned download + manifest.

auditor_jane: Can you confirm logs include KMSEvent=GenerateDataKey and Decrypt entries? Also who is POC for follow-ups?

kevin_devops: Confirmed: logs contain GenerateDataKey and Decrypt entries with associated request IDs. POC is kevin_devops@redwood.ai (also @kevin_devops on Slack). I'll tag here when upload finishes.

evidence_bot: Upload complete: upload_id=eb-20240912-42 status=complete link=https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/soc2/2024/auditor_jane/kms-hsm-rotation-2023-10_2024-09/kms-hsm-rotation-bundle.tar.gz?presigned=true

sam_engsec: Posted evidence packet: evidence_id=EVID-2024-0912-7 manifest attached. Top-level hash: sha256:9f2c7a8d4e6b... :thumbsup:

auditor_jane: Received, downloaded, and verified the top-level hash. Bundle includes rotation CSV, KMS audit logs subset, CloudHSM module events, retention statement, and the reproducibility steps. I'll review and follow up if I need deeper samples. Thanks all.
